title: A title part move dragged by hand on the timeline survives a restyle
goal: When someone drags one of a title part's own movement bars on the timeline (the Headline's Opacity, Position or Scale), that change is thrown away the next time anything about the title changes: retiming another part, a theme, the energy or intensity. Their edit should stay, or the bar should not be draggable in a way that gets silently undone.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-17 by a core probe (Tests, deleted after): Keynote title, headline opacity motion retimed 3520->3220 ms via LayerMotion.retimed, then doc.retimeTitlePart(layerID:index:2,grab:.start,byMS:300): headline opacity back at MotionTiming(startMS: 3520, durationMS: 400). Cause: restyleTitle -> refitTitle recompiles every part (applyTitleDesign replaces motions for every property the design moves), so a direct edit of compiled keys is lost. Predates a-title-page-s-parts-each-have-their-own-labelle (any restyle did it), which makes it easier to hit. Options: store per-part overrides in the recipe, or route bar drags on a title part's compiled motions into the design (a part's in/out builds), or recompile only the part that changed.
acceptance: Drag the Headline's Opacity bar 0.3 s earlier, then drag the Subtitle's start later: the Headline's Opacity bar is still where it was dragged
The same holds after changing the title's theme, energy and intensity
A walk does the drag, the restyle and the check at Next defaults
The same holds for an animated chart: a key or effect set by hand on one bar survives changing the chart's numbers or theme
